description.label: Description
description.value: Years of practice and development of other senses allows you to fight in close combat without the benefit of sight. This Talent reduces the penalties for fighting with a melee weapon while suffering from obscured vision, permitting you to fight in fog, smoke, or darkness more effectively. You can ignore the -10 penalty from a @Condition[Blinded] Condition. Each level in this Talent lets you ignore the -10 penalty from an extra @Condition[Blinded] Condition. Note this Talent only improves a character’s chances to hit with melee weapons and has no effect on ranged weapon attacks.
